kwi/h1 g'e/rh2ont k'o/ns dhg'hu/Hn_s se/nh2s? tn_tlo/m we/kwsperoy de/h2newi tn_ne/wmi. h1i/m h2ewse/r h1e/g'hs de/wkmi dhg'hu/Hes-kwe h1e/smi h1e/n le/ghonti. dhg'hu/Hes tn_tlo:/d ne bhebhih2e:/r? tn_tlo/m kr_sno/y we/dni ne dedr_k'e:/r. tn_tlo/m me/g'hye k'o/m h2ewse/r de/wkesi? h2e/yeri gwe/moh2 h1i/m-kwe de/wkoh2.

kwi/d me/h2ter h1e/nosyo pr_kwe/ws h2ewlo/y h1e/sti? sweh2du/ me/lit h1e/smi h1e/n h1e/sti. h1i/d sle/h2gwomes? h1i/d sle/h2gwomes h2ewlo/s-kwe bhe/rg'hus. do/ru k'e/nesi? bherHg'o/m po/s de/mi pe/ruti k'e/nm_. nu sh2e/ymn_ we/dhe ph2te/rm_-kwe toy e/nu ste/yghe. me/lit moy de/h3esi? h1i/d toy de/h3oh2 swo/ybhos-kwe bhre/h2tr_bhos h1i/d de/deh3esi.

po/tni moy bhre/h2te:r do:/m pe/runs ne gwegwo/me. kwo/m le/ytt? h2o/wins dhg'hye/s upo/ h2e/g'et ne/kwti-kwe sne/ygwhet. h3mi/ghleh2 pe/runi k'e/yor mo/rto:s-kwe h3mi/ghleh2i h3slidhe/nt. k'wo/nn_s sl_h2gwdhi/ bhre/h2tr_s-kwe toy h1no/mn_ h2e/k'monn_s h1ente/r g'huHe/ye. k'wo/nes h1i/m wido:/nti? to/y h2ne/rm_ h3e/donti h1i/m wido:/nti. n_sye/h1t.

po/tni wiHro:/s de/h2nu e/ti sth2e/h1yonti. kwo/ti wiHro:/s h1se/nti? septm_/ wiHro:/s. g'hoyso/ns bhe/ronti. h1e/yes gho/steyes? h1i/ns ne g'n_ne/h3mi. h1e/yso:m dn_g'hwe/h2m ne wo/ydh2e. h1i/d me: te/rh2s gwe/ru-kwe me: Hye/h1ks. g'e/rh2ontn_s dhh1tle/h2m g'huHe/ye.

h2e/nHe moy kwelso:/m pe/runo:m spe/lom we/wke. mo/ri pe/rwo:r e/ti k'e/yor. kwi/d mo/ri? mo/ri me/g'h2 wo/dr_ h1e/syo-kwe kwis te/rmn_ ne dedo/rk'e. h2e/nHe h1i/d wide/s? h1i/d ne kwe/k'm_ h2e/wh2os-kwe moy h1i/d swe/h2i h2yuHn_te/h2i kwe/k't. we/wket moy. dhg'hu/Hes h2e/n neh2ubho/s me/g'yoses. h1i/d we/ydsoh2. h2uksdhi/ nu-kwe h1e/yomes.

h1su/k'lewes wl_/kwos h2egwno/m ne/kwti h1e/pt. ne bhe/wdhes? k'e/mh2m_ se/sm_-kwe. wl_/kwos k'o/syeh2i ne/kwti h2ew gwe/meti. h1i/m g'hoyso:/ys h2o/wins h1ente/r me/no:mes. k'wo/nn_s g'huHe/yo:h2? h1i/ns g'huHe/ye dhe/nwr_-kwe we/dhe. k'o/syeh2i ne/kwti ne se/soh2. wl_/kwos n_sme/d ne bhe/wgeti.

bhre/h2ter ta/wrom wre/go:mes. ta/wros h1e/k'wo:d me/g'yo:s h1e/syo-kwe k'r_h2no:/s h2ek'ro:/s. ta/wrom dedo/rk'th2e? dwo/h1 ta/wroh1 lime/ni h1e/pi dedo/rk'h2e. nu h1me/ k'ludhi/. ta/wros nos ph2tre/s bhre/h2term_ gwhe/nt. nu de/k'm_ wiHro:/ys k'o/m gwe/h2omes. de/k'm_ wiHro:/ys pl_h1u/bhis-kwe h1e/k'wo:ys deywo:/s-kwe nos ph2sih1e/nt.

gwe:/n h1o/lk'im more/yome h1e/syeh2s-kwe toy ye:/kwr_ we/dhoh2. kwi/s h1i/h2m_ h1e/st? h1i/h2m_ moy g'hoyso/h1 h2we/gm_. nu toy ske/wHtis h1e/seti. kwi/h1 me:/ms bhe/h2go:mes? g'r_h2n_tbho/s bhoh2go/m dh3dhi/ deywo/ybhos-kwe k'e:/r de/h3omes. deywo:/s nos h1we/suh2 dh3ih1e/nt. ph2we/ni h1e/pi sddhi/ me:/ms pe/kwo:h2.

sni/gwhs dhubhre/h2 k'o/smi dino/y wre/go:mes? h1o/lk'is dhubhre/h2i sni/gwhi se/ngwt h1i/h2m_-kwe upe/r ste/yghomes. po/dh1e moy go/letes. to/h1 h2wl_/h1neh2h1 wose/ye h1me/-kwe e/nu ste/yghe. h1o/lk'is bherHg'o/ysu po/s sth2e/h1yeti. nu gwe/ru Hih1kdhi/ Hye/h1koh2-kwe. pe/h3lHt. h1i/h2m_ kl_h2me/.

bhre/h2ter moy toy dhe/nwr_ de/yk'e. k'o/d dhe/nwr_ se/nom. h1i/d nos h2e/wh2osyo h1e/st. to/nom toy h2o:/ws h2e/d dukdhi/ nu h1sdhi/. kwi/d h1e/soh2? h2e/nh2tn_s lime/ni h1sdhi/. h1e/sm_ h2e/nh2ts-kwe wo/dr_ h1n_do/ se/ngwt. sn_h2dhi/ h1i/h2m_-kwe we/dhe. me/h2te:r nos h1i/h2m_ pe/kwe:ti.

kwo/s g'hwe:/r me/h2ter lime/ni sne/h2ti? h1e/neh2 udre/h2 dhg'hu/Hn_s-kwe h1e:/dti. kwi/s-kwe h1e/nos? h1e/syo h1orse/h2 pl_th2ene/h2. h1e/nos bhe/bhrus do/ruh2-kwe swo:/ys h3dn_tbhi/s skine/dti. n_sme/d bhebhih2e:/r? n_sme/d bhebhih2e:/r h1yo/d nos k'lush1yo/nti wo/dr_ Hn_dhe/r sn_gwe/nt. th2ke/h1ye h1i/ns-kwe wide:/si.

h2e/wh2e k'aso/m swo:/ys g'ho/sto:ys se/nh2m_. k'aso:/s h2wl_pi/bhos He/Hk'yoses kwi/h1 h1i/m se/nh2s? ghr_h1me/ni swe/pnoy le/ghet h1i/m-kwe h1e/pi pe/dm_. deywo:/s toy h1we/sum dino/m dh3e/nt. h1i/m de/re:si? h2e/wh2e me k'Hsdhi/. h1i/m h1idhe/ we/dhe ske/wHtim-kwe skl_Hdhi/. nu h1i/h2m_ g'ho/sto:ys dukdhi/.

g'n_/h3ra nos h3e/ro: h2o/wins upe/r pe/th2t. h2egwno/m h1e/pt? ne kwid h1e/pt so/h2wl_ pro/ti pe/th2t. to/d h1we/su. ph2te:/r nos dye:/ws ste/h2dhh1om dedo/rk'e. nu h2o/wins bhe/rg'huns h2e/g'rons upo/ h2e/g'o:h2? h1i/h2n_s upo/ h2e/g'e we/kwsperoy-kwe ne/seso. ne/so:h2er h2me/lg'os-kwe toy we/dho:h2.

ph2ter nos k'wo:/ dru/bhos ne ne/st. kwo/m h1i/m wide/s? h2e/yeri twork'o/m e/nu dre/mt. twork'o:/s k'wo/nn_s swo:/ys h3dn_tbhi/s h3wth2e/nt. h1i/m ph2we/nh1 h2isk'o:/mes. k'le/wse. h1i/m srume/ni h2e/nti k'lush1yo/h2. gwi/h3weti h1e/sh2r_-kwe h1e/syo ske/lesi h1e/sti. h1i/m do:/m bhe/re h1e/syo ske/los le/wh3o:h2. h1i/m bhe/ro:h2.

de/h2nu tl_h2to/y pe/romes pl_h1e/wih2es h1o/lh1nih2es h2e/n h1se/nti. nu de/h2nu dhubhno/m pe/runsu h2we/rst. neh2we/h1 pe/romes. h1e/noy-kwe nos wiHro:/s h3eh3de:/r. ne nos wido:/nti ne/kwti h1e/yomes h2use/si-kwe ne/so:mesdhh2. nu h1ite/ ne/h2wm_-kwe dre/wi h1e/pi bhe/ndhete. n_sih1te/.

po/tni toy twork'o/s wiHro/m h3wa/th2t. ku/dhe h1e/y h1e/sti? gwi/h3weti? gwi/h3weti to/syo bhre/h2teres h1i/m bhe/ronti. h1i/m h2e/Hsh2m_ h2e/d we/dhe h1i/m-kwe str_h3me/ni loghe/ye. wo/dr_ moy h2wl_/h1neh2m-kwe bhe/re. me/reti? ne me/reti deywo:/s h1i/m lubhyo/nti. deywo:/s te k'luwih1e/nt.

kwe/syo ske/wHtis ph2ter k'e/h2? k'e/h2 h2r_/tk'osyo ske/wHtis h2r_/tk'om moy h2yuHn_te/h2i more/yom. we/wke moy. kwi/h1 h1i/m more/yes? h2r_/tk'os g'hime/ni swo:/d le/ghesos h1e/g'hs gwe/mt. ste/h2t g'hoyso/m-kwe moy h1e/syo k'e:/r h1n_do/ Hye/h1km_. ne bhe/yh2s? bhe/yh2m_ g'ho/stos-kwe moy ne tre/mt.

po/tni h1eg'o/h2 gho/stis kwelso/ybhos pe/runbhos gwegwo/mh2e. k'e/ywe gho/stey. priHo/s nos h1sdhi/. h2Hse/h2i sddhi/. kwi/d toy h1no/mn_? h1eg'o/h2 deywo/g'enh1e:s. kwi/d h2e/n h1e/sti? pl_th2eno/s nos lo/kus k'o/ymoy po/s k'e/yor mo/rto:s-kwe h1e/smi h2e/nti tk'iye/nti. skwa/lons h1e/dn_ti gwo:/s-kwe ne ph2se/nti. dye:/m g'n_nh3e/nti? dye:/m we/do:r-kwe g'huHe/yonti.

kwse/pi kwid k'le:/m. so/ wl_/kwos? so/ g'he:/r. h2r_/tk'o:d bhe/yh2m_. h2r_/tk'o:s g'hime/ni sse/nti nu-kwe g'he/yo:m h1e/sti. pe/h2wr_ h2e/le ssdhi/-kwe. bhe/wdhe:si? bhe/wdho:h2 no/kwtm_-kwe te pe/r h2le/kso:h2. nu se/soh2 h2ste/res nos spe/k'yonti.

me/h2ter dhuh2mo/s dweh2ro:/d kl_Hne/s u/d h1e/yti. gho/steyes pe/h2wr_ dhh1e/nt. h1e/yes po/yk'o:s? ne wo/ydh2e po/yk'o:s nos gwo:/s pe/ruti ste/h2yont. gwo:/s gwowsth2o/m h1n_do/ h2e/g'e. h2ne/rn_s g'huHe/yo:h2? h1i/ns g'huHe/ye wik'po/teyey-kwe wr_h1dhi/. mo/k's te/kwo:h2.

h2nr_/menes dhubhro/m wo/dr_ pro/ti h1r_h1ye/. kwi/d h1r_h1yo:/h2? skwa/lo:s h2e/n le/ghonti ne/wos-kwe moy tn_tlo/s k'uh1ro/s. h1r_h1yo/h2. tn_tlo/m Hih1kdhi/. tn_tlo/s gwr_h2u/s. HruHye/. me/g'h2s skwa/los. h1e/y neh2we/s dwe/h2yo:s. k'o/ymos h1i/m h1e/deti. de/h2newey-kwe h1e/syo k'e/rh2sonm_ de/h3omes.

ku/dhe swe/sor so/h2wl_ ne/kwti h1e/yti? h2e/nHos nos to/d mle/wHti. so/h2wl_ mo/ri we/kwsperoy we/yk't. ku/dhe-kwe h2e/yeri me/lh3t? dhg'hme/s tr_me/ns h2ewse/r me/lh3t. dhg'hme/s kwis te/rmn_ h1ludhe/t? h1i/d kwis ne h1ludhe/t h1e/ymn_ dweh2ro/m. nu ssdhi/ lo/wksneh2 te h2le/kseti.

kwi/d h1sn_/tyok'lewes h1o/lh1nih2 bhe/wgt? th2ke/h1yom. h2e/nh1mos twe/d h1o/lh1nih2m pro/ti h1e/yt h1i/h2-kwe te h3e/det. kwi/h1 h2e/nh1mom g'ne/h3oh2? h2sowso/m ghre/h1mn_ tl_nh2dhi/ h1i/d-kwe spe/k'ye. h2e/nh1mom pro/ti ste/yghe. k'o/d memo/nh2e. h1yo/d h1i/d memo/nth2e h1o/lh1nih2 te ne h3e/de:ti.

h2e/nHe h2e/ngwhis bhr_h1we/ni h2e/nti le/gheti h1e/smo:d-kwe dedwo/yh2e. h1e/y kr_sno/s h1e/y-we: k'a/snos? h1e/y kr_sno/s h1e/syo-kwe k'e/rh2so: h1rudhro/s. so/ de/nk't h1i/m me: dhe/gwhh2s. h1i/m h2k'mn_bhi/s gwe/lh1oh2. h1i/m me: more/yes. h2e/ngwheyes bhre/h1wo:r h2le/ksonti. nu me/no:mes le/yteti.

ku/dhe g'r_/h2enti g'hh2e/nses pe/th2onti? g'hime/ni kwelso/y mre/y h2e/nti tk'iye/nti so/h2wl_-kwe h2e/n gwhermo/m. ne/so:ntor? we/sni ne/sontor nu gerh2e/nes gwm_yo/nti. h1i/h2bhi k'o/m pe/th2oyh1m_. te/k'nom toy pe/th2o:r ne h1e/sti po/dh1e-kwe toy HeHk'u/h1. nu h1i/h2n_s e/nu te/kwo:h2.

h2e/n kwis h1e/sti? po/ntoh1m_ ne dedo/rk'h2e. h1idhe/ h1e/smi. kwi/s tu/H? h1eg'o/h2 wik'po/teys suHnu/s h3mi/ghleh2i h3sle/ydhm_. me/h2te:r toy Hre/wdHti ph2te:/r-kwe twe/ h2isk'e/ti. wo/kwm_ moy pro/ti gwm_dhi/. gwm_sk'o/h2 ske/lesh2-kwe moy k'ek'o/mh2e. g'ho/stom moy sl_h2gwdhi/ h2o/weyes toy we/kwsperoy n_se/nt. pri/He moy tu/H k'e/ywos.

gwe:/n bhebhre/wo:m ske/wHtins de/h2nu e/ti we/g'hoh2. kwi/d h1i/h2n_s h2m_bhi/ we/k'si? m_dhe/ws kwe/rom we/k'mi. ske/wHteyes toy pe/h2ureh2es pe/h2urom toy kwe/rom de/h3oh2. nu moy pe/h2urom kwe/rom dh3dhi/ g'hime/ni h2ew h1ludho:/h2. g'hime/ni gwm_dhi/ wl_/kwo:m-kwe nos ske/wHlons we/g'he. h1i/ns we/g'ho:h2 polh1u/-kwe me/lit h1a/yoh2er.

h1we/suk'lewes moy h2yuHn_k'o/syo h2n_re/s spe/lom wr_h1dhi/. h2yuHn_k'o/s h2ne:/r pe/rkwuns h1ente/r wre/get. wl_kwi/h2m_ swo:/ys te/k'no:ys k'o/m re/h1tt h1i/h2m_-kwe ne more/yet. g'hime/ni sni/gwhi h3sle/ydht wl_kwi/h2s-kwe h1i/m do:/m wodhe/yet. to/d spe/lom h1so/nt? g'e/rh2ontes h1i/d mluHe/nti h1i/ns pre/k'sdhi. h1i/ns pre/k'soh2 wl_kwi/h2m_-kwe ne more/yo:h2.

kwi/s gho/stey h1o/lk'is? h1o/lk'is me/g'h2s g'hwe:/r h1i/h2 h1e/k'wo:d me/g'yo:s. h1e/syeh2s k'r_h2no:/s pl_th2eno:/s h1e/syeh2s-kwe ske/lesh2 dweh2re/h2. h1o/lk'eyes h1idhe/ tk'iye/nti? h1idhe/ ne tk'iye/nti k'olHto/ysu limn_su/ tk'iye/nti. kwi/h1 h1i/h2n_s se/h2gyesi? h1i/h2n_s dhubhre/h2m sni/gwhm_ h2e/g'omes h1e/syeh2i-kwe h1e/n ne te/kwonti. h1o/lk'im kwk'ye/h1m_.

me/h2ter dweh2ro/ns bhe/rg'hons h2yuHn_k'o:/ys h2nr_bhi/s k'o/m ye/h2mi. kwo/m ne/se:th2er? h1yo/d lo/wksneh2 ne/weh2 bhu/Heti ne/so:mesdhh2. k'a:/m h2wl_/h1neh2m k'o/d-kwe k'e/strom sl_h2gwdhi/. dhubhre/h2 sre/wmn_h2 kwse/pi me: te/rh2s. h1i/h2 kwse/pi ne te/rh2oh2. su/Hnew moy n_sye/h1s. ne/soh2 bhebhre/ws-kwe toy ske/wHtim h1ope/yo:h2.

su/Hs moy gwru/h1 pe/h3lHt. pri/He toy gwru/h1 ne pe/h3lHt. gwe/ru moy h1e/syo k'e:/r h2we/gt. h1i/m spe/k'yo:mes. dr_k'dhi/. gwe/ru moy h1e/syo k'e/rdi h1idhe/ h1e/sti. h1so/nt bhe/h2si tu/H me/d h1we/syo:s. me:/ms dwi/s bhe/h2go:mes k'e/rh2sonm_-kwe toy de/h3oh2. tu/H h1we/sus priHo/s.

wi/k'potey tr_syo/h2 kwelso/ybhos kl_Hn_bho/s h1ludho/m. k'o/d me/dhu ph3dhi/ me/lit pr_kwu/bhos sl_h2gwme/. h1i/d sweh2du/. ku/dhe me/lit r_h1tte/? h1i/d g'r_h2n_tye/h2s bheh2g'o/syo h2ewlo/y kl_He/ni r_h1tme/. kwi/d-kwe toy h1ime/ni dedo/rk'th2e? kr_sno/m wl_/kwom suHo:/m-kwe ste/h2dhh1om de/rk'm_. sddhi/ sto/yghosyo-kwe nos toy spe/lom we/wke.

h2e/nHe k'le/wse. gerh2e/nes sre/wmn_ upe/r HrudHe/nti. h1yo/d gerh2e/nes gwm_yo/nti sno/ygwhos tine/h1ti. suHne/wes moy su/Hn_s h2ew wre/go:nti. h1me/ h1e/ybhi k'o/m sle/h2gwonti? tu/H h2yuHn_k'e/h2 h1i/ns pre/k'sdhi. h1i/ns pre/k'soh2 h1e/yso:m-kwe dhe/nwo:r bhe/ro:h2.

me/h2ter h2wl_/pis h2o:wye/h2 g'hh2n_se/s nisdo:/d ste/h2yet. ku/dhe h2wl_/pis gwe/h2t? h3okwe/h2m h1n_do/ bherHg'o/y Hn_dhi/ dre/h2t. we/kwsperoy h2ew gwm_ye:/ti. g'hh2e/nsn_s do:/m h1n_do/ dhh1dhi/ k'wo/nm_-kwe nisdo/y h2e/nti sode/ye. k'wo:/ h2wl_/pim dn_k'ye/h1t. nu g'hh2e/nses h2wl_pe/ys ne tre/so:nti. nisdo/m-kwe spe/k'yo:h2.

kwi/d g'e/rh2ont diwe/y h2use/si de/h3omes? h2me/lg'os dhe/g'ho:m g'hudhi/ h1e/smey-kwe se/lpos h1ope/ye. nu wr_h1dhi/. dye/w nos sph1ro/m su/Hm_ dh3dhi/. k'le/weti nos? h1yo/s h1so/nth2 we/kwesh2 bhe/h2ti dye:/ws to/m k'lush1ye/ti. nu h1so/nth2 we/kwesh2 bhe/h2oh2 h1e/smey-kwe ye:/kwr_ de/h3oh2.

nu moy su/Hnew h3o/kwih1 ml_dwi/h1. kwi/d k'o/smi dino/y de/rk's? ta/wro:m ste/h2dhh1om kr_sno/y le/k\wi h2e/nti dr_k'me/. kl_h2te/ kwim? h1suh1e/k'wos kwim gwru/h1 ke/lh2t bhe/wgt-kwe. h1yo/d h2yuHn_k'o/s h1e/sm_ tri/ns ta/wrons more/yom. memo/nh2e to/d nos spe/lom we/wkes. h2use/si n_sme/y k'o/m gwm_dhi/ lime/ni sddhi/. gwe/moh2 k'e:/r-kwe moy me/wdeti.

po/tey ne/s. kwi/d pe/rwo:r e/ti kwe/k's? me/g'h2 mo/ri kwe/k'm_ mo/rto:s-kwe de/mbhos me/g'yosn_s ne/h2wn_s h1e/smi h1e/pi h1r_h1yo/nti. to/syeh2s tewte/h2s gho/stis h1e/s? h1e/syeh2s gho/stis h1e/sm_ dhg'hu/Hn_s moy se/h2lm_-kwe dh3e/nt. k'o/m-kwe toy k'ubhro/m h2e/k'monm_ mre/ys h1ope/yoh2. h1e/y k'ubhro/s. tu/H moy h2k'mn_bho/s pre/yHyo:s.

h2e/nHe moy toy h2yuHn_te/h2m we/wke. h1yo/d h1eg'o/h2 h2yuHn_k'e/h2 h1e/sm_ ph2tre/s moy de/mi gwi/h3wom. h1eg'o/h2 HeHk'e/wih2 h1e/sm_ de/h2nu-kwe moy bhre/h2tr_bhis dre:/m. tu/H k'ubhre/h2 h1e/s? h1eg'o/h2 k'ubhre/h2 h1e/sm_ polh1e/wes-kwe me wiHro:/s uk'e/nt. h2e/wh2om toy we/lh1m_. kwi/d h1i/m we/lh1s? sweh2du/h2 ke/h2nmn_h2 gwe/Hyet ne-kwe me dhrughye/t. h2e/wh2osyo moy ke/h2nmn_ gwe/Hye. nu ne/pot k'le/wse.

g'e/rh2ont nos kh3te/ws spe/lom we/wke. po/yk'o:s h2use/si gwme/nt gwo:/s-kwe nos h2e/g'ont. g'hoyso/m moy h1e/pm_ h1i/ns-kwe se/kwoh2e. ne bhe/yh2s? bhe/yh2m_ ne-kwe bhe/wgm_. po/yk'o:m wik'po/tim pr_we/ni gwhe/nm_. h1i/ns h2e/ti we/dhes? h1i/ns h2e/ti we/dhom ph2te:/r-kwe moy h1me/ gwr_ne/Ht. nu moy h2r_Hmo/h1 ml_du/h1. k'le/wos moy n_/dhgwhitom.

ph2ter ste/h2dhh1eh2 ne/wons h2e/g'rons h2e/g'omes. n_sme/y k'o/m gwm_dhi/. ph2te/res moy k'o/syeh2i dhg'he/mi k'e/yror. h1e/ybhi me/no:h2. kwi/s te h2e/le:ti? ne/po:ts moy h1me/ h2e/le:ti. h2e/ti te ne wido:/mes. h1ite/ we/kwsperoysu-kwe me memn_te/. deywo:/s wos wodhe/yoyh1ent.

wi/k'potey me k'ludhi/. kwi/s gho/stey tu/H kwi/s-kwe te se/lg't? h1e/tereh2s me tewh2te/h2s h3re:/g's se/lg't. de/h2nu e/ti tk'iye/nti. kwi/d n_sme/d h2epo/ we/k'ti? kwye/h1tim tewh2ta:/s h1ente/r we/k'ti. de/k'm_ toy h1e/k'wons bhoydha:/s de/deh3ti. h3re:g'e/s we/kwos h1e/k'woybhos h1we/syos. h1o/ytom deywo:/ys h3m_ne/h3eti? h1i/m h3m_ne/h3eti deywo:/s-kwe h1i/m wido:/nti. nu toy ne/weh2i lo/wksneh2i h3re:g'e/h1 k'o/m h2e/ti gwm_dhi/.

pri/He toy moy g'he/sorm_ de/deh3mi. g'he/sorm_ toy h1a/yh2e. kwi/d h3m_ne/h3owos? k'o/d h3m_ne/h3owos do:/m moy toy do:/m. h1yo/d moy do:/m gwe/mesi ph2we/ni moy h1e/pi sede/h1ye:si me:/ms-kwe moy h1e/desi. nu toy h2e/h2usosyo pe/h3tlom de/h3oh2. do/h3r_ toy moy priHo/m. k'o/m moy h1e/k'wom ste/h2dhh1osyo He/Hk'istom h1a/yso. deywo:/s nos h1o/ytom wido/yh1ent pe/rkwunos-kwe dhrughyo/ntm_ mo/rtom gwhn_ye/h1t. k'e/ywe h1i/m h3m_ne/h3mi.

gho/stey toy we/kwesh2 k'lush1yo/h2 h1i/h2 ne wo/ydh2e. dn_g'hwe/h2s moy toy ne dn_g'hwe/h2s. pe/h2ureh2 moy werdheh2 wo/ydth2e? pe/h2ureh2 wo/ydh2e h1i/h2 h2e/ti we/wke. h3re:g'e/s do:/m h2isk'o/h2 ku/dhe tk'e/yti? nu toy werdheh2 wo/ydh2e. h1e/nom ko/lHonm_ e/ti tk'e/yti. h1i/m me pro/ti we/dhe:si? se/h2lm_ toy de/h3oh2. se/h2lm_ moy dh3dhi/ we/dho:h2-kwe te.

suHnu/m toy moy bhoydhe/h2m de/deh3mi. k'o/ymoy toy gwi/h3we:ti. nu toy moy bhre/h2tr_s suHnu/m de/deh3mi. h1i/m pe/h2sesi? h1i/m pe/h2soh2 suHnu/bhis-kwe moy k'o/m h1e/deti. kwo/m suHnu/h1 ne/so:ntor? ti/srn_s g'he/yomn_s me/ne:tes. nu ne/so:ntor. h1yo/d toy tewh2te/h2 kwye/h1tim Hrune/peti suHnu/s toy ne ne/se:tor. tewh2te/h2 moy h1i/h2m_ ne Hrune/peti. h1i/h2m_ ph2tre/h1 diwe/h1 h3m_ne/h3mi.

po/tni ke/h2ileh2 h1sdhi/. h3re:g'e/s h2epo/ gwm_yo/h2. pri/He gho/stey. sddhi/ h1ddhi/-kwe. nu moy we/kwesh2 k'ludhi/. po/teys moy suHnu/s po/tnih2m h2isk'e/ti. dhugh2te/rm_ toy we/k'ti. kwo/d h1we/dmn_ de/h3eti? de/k'm_ gwo:/s h2e/h2usosyo-kwe pe/h3tlom de/h3eti. me/ne moy dhugh2te:/r priHe/h2. h1i/h2m_ pre/k'soh2. h1yo/d h1i/m we/k'eti te/bhye k'o/m h1e/yeti.

kwi/d toy nos po/h2imen gwo/wes ghr_h1me/ni h1se/nti? ph2te/res nos te/rmn_ de/h2newi dhh1e/nt. h1i/d kl_He/ni dhh1e/nt. g'e/rh2ontes h1i/d wide:/r. nu nos tewh2te/h2o:m g'e/rh2ontn_s pre/k'sowos. me: wiko:/wos. ke/h3tum ne we/k'mi. gwo:/s toy nos ghr_h1me/ns h2epo/ h1l_h2dhi/. k'wo/nn_s toy moy h2e/wibhos h2epo/ dhore/ye. g'e/rh2ontes toy h2ewse/r gwm_sk'o:/nti? we/ sm_me/nesh1e.

kwo/syeh2s toy tewh2te/h2s wo/g'hoh1 k'o/m gwegwo/mth2e? dweh2ro:/d mre/ys gwegwo/mh2e. mo/ri dedo/rk'th2e? h1i/d ne dedo/rk'h2e. kwi/d bhe/resi? se/h2lm_ h2e/yos-kwe bhe/roh2. kwi/d moy de/h3esi? h2wl_/h1neh2m toy ske/wHtins-kwe de/h3oh2. h2wl_/h1neh2 toy h1use/wih2. h1i/h2m_ moy wo/g'hom h2ewse/r bhe/re. h1i/h2m_ bhe/ro:h2 swe/so:r-kwe moy swe/h2m h2wl_/h1neh2m de/h3eti.

kwi/d pri/He k'o/syo h2e/h2usosyo h2elgwho/s? k'o/d h2e/h2usom septm_/ h2o/wins h2e/lgwheti. septm_/ h2o/weyes. dhrughye/si me. ne te dhrughyo/h2. h1i/d dweh2ro/ybhos pe/runbhos h2epo/ bhe/rom. kwi/d h1ope/yesi? kwe/tesrn_s h2o/wins ka/prom-kwe h1ope/yoh2. pe/nkwe h2o/wins dh3dhi/ h2e/h2usom-kwe sl_h2gwdhi/. pe/nkwe de/h3oh2. tu/H dhr_su/s h2ne:/r. tu/H g'n_h3ro/s. h2e/h2usom mo/wdoh1 we/so.

kwe/yes me/h2ter h1e/noy h2ne/res pr_we/ni? h1e/yes gho/steyes. h2use/s gwm_sk'o/nti. kwi/d nos ph2tre/h1 k'o/m bhh2e/nti? sto/yghom pe/rwo:r pe/r h2isk'o/nti. h1i/ns we/dhe:ti. do/h3r_ moy e/ti de/h3onti? h1yo/d th2ke/h1ye:si h1i/d toy de/h3onti. me/h2ter th2ke/h1yo:h2. nu h1idhi/ h1e/yso:m-kwe wo/g'hons spe/k'ye. h1i/ns wide/h1yesi?

h2e/wh2e ghoste/yo:m dn_g'hwe/h2m wo/ydth2e. kwi/h1 h1i/h2m_ h1e/wks? h1yo/d h2yuHn_k'o/s h1e/sm_ h1pe/nt me. septm_/ g'he/yomn_s h1e/yso:m wo/yk'oy gwi/h3wom. stunde/nt te? ne me stunde/nt. h1e/yso:m me gwe/nh2es h2me/lg'esh1 me/msh1-kwe h2e/lont. nu h1e/yso:m dn_g'hwe/h2m h1e/wkm_. k'e/Hsoh2 te? h2e/wh2e me k'Hsdhi/. k'le/wso:h2.

bhre/h2ter h2e/ti gwegwo/mth2e. septm_/ te se/ma:s ne wide/h1yome. swe/sor gwegwo/mh2e. ph2te:/r nos me/h2te:r-kwe gwi/h3wetes? gwi/h3wetes. nu nos me/h2te:r se/neh2 Hre/wdHti-kwe toy. h1e/yes toy h1we/sewes h1se/nt? h1e/yso:m moy wik'po/tis h1we/sus h1e/st. h1e/syo ph2we/ni h1e/pi h1e:/dm_. h1e/syo moy dhugh2te:/r priHe/h2. nu h1i/h2m_ snuso/m do:/m we/dhe:si. g'e/nh1torh1e nos pre/k'soh2.

swe/k'ruh2 ne/kwti Hre/wdHmi. kwi/d Hre/wdHsi? snu/se nos tu/H ne priHe/h2? tu/H moy k'e/yweh2. me/h2tr_s moy dn_g'hwe/h2m lubhyo/h2. tewh2te/h2 toy tri/ns bhe/rg'hons e/ti tk'e/yti. bhre/h2te:r toy we/sni n_sme/ pro/ti gwm_ye:/ti. bhre/h2te:r moy gwm_ye:/ti? gwm_ye:/ti. me/g'hye k'o/m bhh2dhi/ dn_g'hwe/h2m-kwe toy h1e/wkoh2. nu te me/h2ter k'e/Hsoh2.

h2yuHn_k'o:/s toy nos h1e/k'wons kwse/pi ste/h2yont. h1i/ns ne ste/h2yome. h1e/k'wo:s toy ko/lHonn_s dr_me/nt. nu toy kwi/d gho/rdhoy h1n_do/m h1se/nti? suHne/wes moy h1i/ns wido/nt h1i/ns-kwe h1n_do/ we/dhont. h1i/ns h2e/ti h1a/yso. h1o/ynos h1e/k'wos lelo/ykwe. nu toy h1e/syo h2elgwho/m kwine/woh2. h1i/m h2e/yesh1 kwinudhi/ kwye/h1tis-kwe nos tewh2ta:/s h1ente/r h1e/stu. tewh2te/h2 toy h1i/h2m_ dhore/ye:ti?

po/tis moy k'o/d mle/wHti de/h2nus nos h2e/g'rom dh3dhi/ g'hoyso:/ys-we: gwm_yo:/mes. po/tis toy me te/rgweti? po/teyey toy wr_h1dhi/ ph2te/res nos k'o/m h2e/g'rom dhore/yont. h2yuHn_k'o:/s nos polh1e/wes ne-kwe bhebhih2e:/r. tu/H dhr_su/s. ko/ryos ste/h2dhh1oybhos h2egho/s. nu toy po/tis h1me/ pro/ti gwe/mtu bhe/h2owos-kwe. we/kwesh2 toy h1i/m pro/ti bhe/ro:h2.

gwe:/n h1eg'o/h2 gho/stis go/loh2-kwe. pe/h2wr_ wik'dhi/ h1ddhi/-kwe. deywo:/s toy h1we/suh2 dh3ih1e/nt. nu moy toy h2ne/r h1no/mn_ wr_h1dhi/. kwo/smo:d g'n_h1ye/th2e? h1suk'le/wesos g'n_h1yo/h2e. ste/h2dhh1eh2 pe/rwr_ e/ti pe/h2sti. h1suk'le/wesm_ g'n_ne/h3mi. de/mi moy gho/stis h1e/st. nu nos tu/H priHo/s. h1yo/d moy wo/yk'om gwe/mesi ph2we/ni moy h1e/pi sede/h1ye:si.

kwi/d nos h2yu/Hn_k'e bhr_h1we/ns pi/ph3esi? bhre/h1wr_ nos h2susye/ti. nu ph3dhi/. ka/pro:s toy h1idhe/ me: ph3e/nt. kwi/d toy h1no/mn_? h1eg'o/h2 h1sume/ne:s. kwi/s tu/H? h1eg'o/h2 h2nr_me/ne:s. h2e/nHo:s nos sokwe/yonti tewh2te/h2 toy nos po/yk'o:s. h2e/nHo:s polh1u/h2 sokwe/yonti. h1eg'o/h2 toy ne po/yk'os. nu h2e/yeri gwm_sk'e/ bhr_h1we/ni-kwe h1e/pi lo/ygo:wos.

g'e/rh2ont nos de/h2nus tewh2te/h2 po/yk'o:s h1e/st? po/yk'o:s nos h1se/nt. gwho/nom pr_we/ni memo/nh2e. h1e/yso:m nos wiHro:/s gwo:/s h2e/g'ont wiHro:/s-kwe nos polh1u/ns gwhne/nt. nu kwi/d kwye/h1tis h1e/sti? wik'po/tis nos h1e/yso:m wik'po/teyey swe/h2m dhugh2te/rm_ de/h3t. nu nos h1e/syeh2s te/k'neh2 k'o/ymeh2 ste/h2dhh1eh2-kwe nos ph2se/nti. kwye/h1tis sth2e/h1ye:ti? sth2e/h1ye:ti h1yo/d mo/rto:s swo/ns h1o/ytons dhore/yo:nti. h1i/ns g'n_ne/h3si?

ne/k'um toy te/we bhre/h2term_ we/g'homes. kwi/s h1i/m gwhe/nt? tewh2te/h2s nos h2yuHn_k'o/s h1i/m kh3te/wi gwhe/nt. wik'po/tis nos toy kwoyne/h2m se/lg't. h1i/h2 k'm_to/m gwo/wes. gwo/wes moy me/ne bhre/h2term_ h2e/ti de/h3onti? h1i/m h2e/ti ne de/h3onti. kwoyne/h2m h1a/yso h2yuHn_k'o/m-kwe nos me: kwe/yeth2e. h1i/h2m_ h1a/yoh2er. gwhe/nto:r moy pe/h2wr_ me: gwe/mt. ne gwe/meti. deywo:/s toy bhre/h2trey kwye/h1tim dh3ih1e/nt.

wi/Hre h1e/tereh2 tewh2te/h2 swe/h2m bhoydhe/h2m Hrune/pt. ste/h2dhh1eh2 nos h2e/g'ont. h1i/d g'ne/h3m_. poh2ime/nes moy wr_h1e/nt. kwi/d dhe/dheh1esi? h1i/ns pro/ti h1e/yesi? h2ne/rm_ h1i/ns pro/ti se/lg'oh2. h1yo/d ste/h2dhh1eh2 h2e/ti de/h3onti ko/ryos ne h1e/seti. h1yo/d h1i/h2 h2e/ti ne de/h3onti? nu nos h2yuHn_k'o:/s h1i/ns kwe/yo:ntor pe/rkwunos-kwe h1i/d kwe/k'eti. po/tni dedwo/yth2e?

suHno/wey moy toy swe/sorm_ snuso/m we/k'mi. ph2te:/r nos pe/ruti me/rt. kwo/d h1we/dmn_ bhe/resi? tri/ns h1e/k'wons h2e/yesos kwe/rom h2wl_/h1neh2s-kwe we/smn_ bhe/roh2. me/ne moy swe/so:r h1e/k'woybhos pre/yHyo:s. h2wl_/h1neh2m te/ksti polh1u/h2-kwe ke/h2nmn_h2 wo/yde. nu h2r_g'n_to/syo pe/h3tlom e/ti de/h3oh2. h1i/h2m_ do:/m we/sni we/dhe. h1e/syeh2s swe/k'uros h1e/sesi. tu/H moy k'o/ymos h1e/sesi.

kwo/s sto/yghos dhu/gh2ter wik'po/teys wo/yk'om de/wkti? kwi/s tu/H kwi/d-kwe h1i/m h2isk'e/si? me/ne me po/tis h1e/smey we/kwesbhis se/lg't. sto/yghom de/h2nu e/nu se/kweso. h2ewse/r h1idhi/. h1yo/d so/h2wl_ twe/ upe/r h1e/seti wo/yk'osyo gho/rdhom kwe/k'esi. dhu/gh2ter tu/H h1sume/ne:s. ste/h2dhh1om toy Hwr_dhye/h1t. n_sye/h1s.

se/leso:m toy h2ne/r se/h2lm_ kwrine/h2oh2. kwi/d ghe/ldhe:si? h1i/m g'r_h2no/h1 pe/rh2oh2. h2e/lbhit moy h1e/sti. kwo/ti me/desh2 we/k'si? k'o/m kwe/rom h2l_bhite/h1 pl_nh1dhi/ se/h2lm_-kwe sl_h2gwdhi/. so/ kwe/ros me/g'h2s. me/dos toy pe/h2urom. nu h1i/m se:mi pl_nh1dhi/ pe/h2urom-kwe toy k'e/strom e/ti de/h3oh2. h1idhe/ me/ne. h2e/lbhit we/g'ho:h2.

kwi/h1 toy po/tni tewh2te/h2 ghoste/yey mle/wHti? k'o/d sokwe/yomes. ke/h2ilos h1sdhi/. lewbho/s nos h1sdhi/. somHo/m sokwe/yomes. h1yo/d h1e/y le/yteti kwi/d sokwe/yete? sokwe/yomes. deywo:/s te sto/yghoy ph2sih1e/nt. we/kwesh2 wos nos we/kwesbhos somHe/h2. dn_g'hwe/h2h1 nos swe/sorh1e. h2e/nHos moy toy tewh2te/h2s h1ludhe/t. h1i/d ne wo/ydth2e?

k'wo/nes toy moy ti/srn_s h2o/wins ne/kwti gwhne/nt. h1i/d swo:/ys h3kwbhi/s dedo/rk'th2e? h1i/ns dedo/rk'h2e. h1e/yso:m h1o/h3sh2 h1sh2e/nh1 h1rudhe/h1t. nu toy h2elgwho/m dhl_gho/h2. kwi/d h2o/wis h2e/lgwheti? h2o/wis g'r_h2no/syo me/dos h2e/lgwheti. tri/h2 moy me/desh2 ghe/ldhe k'wo/nn_s-kwe toy bhe/ndhe. ghe/ldho:h2 h1i/ns-kwe bhe/ndho:h2. k'wo/nn_s moy me: stune/ds. h1yo/d h2ew gwm_yo:/nti h1i/ns more/yo:h2.

po/tis moy mle/wHti dh2pno/m nos toy wiHro:/ys gwm_dhi/. kwi/d dh2pno/y h1e/seti? me/dhu me:/ms ke/h2nmn_h2-kwe. g'e/rh2ontes toy n_sme/y k'o/m pi/ph3o:nti somHo:/s-we: toy h2yuHn_k'o:/s pi/ph3o:nti? solh2wo:/s gwm_yo:/nti. nu gwm_yo:/mes. po/teyey toy wetso/m do/h3r_ we/dho:mes. me/wde:ti gwe/Hyo:mes-kwe wos.

po/tni me spr_dhi/. te/k'neh2 moy lubhyo/h2. tu/H kapte/h2. wiHro/s moy te de/k'm_ gwe/wbhis kwrine/h2t. g'n_h1yo/m moy kwoyne/h2m kwine/weti. polh1u/ moy h3e/pnos bhre/h2trey h1e/sti. nu h1e/smey we/kwos sl_g'dhi/. h1yo/d kwine/weti tu/H h1le/wdhereh2 h1e/sesi. kwi/s h1i/m pro/ti h1e/yeti? poh2ime:/n nos we/sni h2e/n ste/ygheti. h1e/smey h1i/d we/rh1eti. ku/dhe tk'e/yti?

h2e/g'rom de/h2newi bhe/h2go:wos. kwo/terom bhoh2go/m h1a/yeth2er? k'o/m bhoh2go/m h1a/yoh2er h1e/nom-kwe toy le/h1oh2. polh1u/ toy ghre/h1mn_ bhoh2go/y h1e/sti pe/h2urom-kwe me/ne bhoh2go/y h1e/sti. nu wl_h1dhi/ ste/h2dhh1om-kwe moy h1e/terom h1e/lh2oh2. k'o/m we/lh1m_. h2e/k'monm_ tr_me/ni dhe/h1owos. dye:/ws k'o/m h2e/k'monm_ spe/k'yoyh1t.

h3re/g' kwe/kwlo:s bhe/rg'hom upe/r h2ewse/r gwm_sk'o/nti. kwo/ti kwe/kwlo:s h1se/nti? wiHro:/s h1e/ybhi me/dhi h1se/nti? septm_/ kwe/kwlons kwe/k'm_. gwe/nh2es te/k'neh2-kwe h1e/ysu h1e/n sede/h1yonti. mo/rto:s ske/ytons bhore/yonti swo/ns g'hoyso/ns bhondhe/yont. ko/ryo:y ne gwm_sk'o/nti. ne/wom h2e/g'rom h2isk'o/nti. h1i/ns h2e/d h1idhi/ pr_h2wo/syo-kwe h1e/yso:m h2n_re/s h1no/mn_ pre/k'sdhi. h1yo/d nos ghr_h1me/ni tk'e/yonti? nu h1e/ybhi me/dhi bhe/h2omes. g'hoyso/ns po/sti tl_ne/h2omes.

kl_Hne/s h1le/wdheyes k'lute/. h3re/g'es me/g'h2i h2k'me/ni g'ne/h3ontor. kwi/s k'o/d k'e/nst? h1i/d k'e/nsm_. kwo/m dhh1tle/h2 h1e/seti? pl_h1ne/h2i lo/wksneh2i h1e/seti. de/k'm_ mo/rtons de/wkonti. g'hoyso/ns bhore/yo:nti? g'hoyso/m kwis ne bhore/ye:ti. deywo:/s h2e/k'monm_ ph2se/nti. nu gwne/h2bhos we/rh1oh2. h1e/ymos me:/ms pe/kwo:mes.

h2e/wh2e po/yk'o:ys wiko:/h2. k'le/wos lubhyo/h2. kwi/d ko/ryom lubhye/si? h2e/lyo:s nos h2egho/m ne dhh1e/nt. n_/k'lewe:s h2ne:/r me/rt h1i/m-kwe kwis ne memo/ne. k'lowse/ye me. h1yo/s kwye/h1tim de/meti so/ n_/dhgwhitom k'le/wos we/nt. h2e/wh2e to/d h1so/nt? to/d h1so/nt. h1sn_tyo/k'lewesm_ gwr_nHme/s h1yo/s kwye/h1tim kl_Hne/s h1ludhi/bhis k'o/m de/met. nu h1e/syo ke/h2nmn_h2 h1e/wkoh2.

g'e/rh2ont deywo/k'lewesm_ h2isk'o/h2. h1eg'o/h2 so/. h3o/kwih1 toy k'e/ywosyo h3kwbho/s somHo/yh1. h1wesuk'le/wesos g'n_h1yo/h2e. h1no/mn_ moy toy we/rh1t. h1wesuk'le/we:s. me/dhu moy ph2we/ni h1e/pi ph3we/ de/h3o:r-kwe kwrih2we/. gwi/h3weti? g'hye/mi me/rt. k'o/d moy toy pe/h3tlom do/h3r_ h1ope/yet. k'o/d pe/h3tlom g'n_ne/h3mi. te/k'nom sddhi/. nu moy tu/H te/k'nom.

gwe:/n moy te/k'nom me:/de:si? to/d moy te/k'nom de/yk'e. h1e:/dti? ne h1e:/dti dhe/gwheti-kwe. h1i/d ghr_h1mn_/bhis me:/do:h2. wo/dr_ toy kwe/roy gwhr_nudhi/. h1i/d gwhr_ne/woh2. kwo/m misdho/m gwhe/dhyesi? h1yo/d gwi/h3we:ti h2wl_/h1neh2s moy we/smn_ dedh3dhi/. h1yo/d gwi/h3we:ti de/k'm_ toy we/smn_h2 de/deh3oh2. nu nos likwdhi/.

Hrupyo/h2 ne Hre/wdHmi.

kwi/d dhh2bhre kwe/roy tine/h1si? h2e/h2usom tine/h1mi. h3re:/g's h2e/h2usosyo pe/h3tlom we/k'ti. kwi/h1 pe/h3tlom h1e/smo:d we/rg'esi? k'o/d sokso/m dhe/lbhm_ h2e/h2usom h1i/d h1n_do/ le/yHoh2. h1i/d le/yHoh2? h1i/d k'o/smi dino/y me: le/yHs h2e/h2usom gwhermo/m. bhebhudhdhi/ memn_dhi/-kwe. kwo/m h2e/h2usom le/yHoh2? h1yo/d toy h2r_Hmo:/s k'uh1ro:/s h1e/sonti h3re:g'bho/s h2e/h2usom le/yHesi.

h1su/h1ek'we moy we/wke kwi/h1 Hro/th2o:y dwo/h1 h1e/k'woh1 ye/wgoh2? ye/wgtreh2 lm_bhdhi/. He/Hk'yosm_ yugdhi/ nu h1e/terom yugdhi/. to/h1 ye/wgm_. Hro/th2om dhr_h3dhi/ g'he/yoh2-kwe. to/h1 HeHk'u/h1. ku/dhe g'he/yomes? ko/lHonm_ g'he/yomes h2e/ti-kwe h1e/romes. g'hidhi/. dye:/ws nos h2le/ksoyh1t.

se/na nos gwe:/n wetso/s ne gwr_h3e/ti dhg'he/mi le/gheti. h1e/syo u/deros ple/h1dhetor? ple/h1dhetor Hrupye/ti-kwe. ne/wom ghre/h1mn_ h2e/k'h3t. se/h2lm_ moy wo/dr_-kwe dh3dhi/. kwi/d dhe/dheh1esi? h1i/d h1e/syo h1o/h3s h1n_do/ se/ykwoh2 h1e/smey-kwe we/kwesh2 h2roh1dhe/yo:h2. wetso/s gwi/h3we:ti? gwi/h3we:ti. k'e/h2 we/kwesh2 h1ukdhi/ tu/H wetso/ns me:/de:si.

h2nr_/menes nos h2e/nterosyo k'o/ymosyo wiHro:/s pe/k'u pe/ruti h2e/g'ont. h2e/ti gwm_yo:/nti? kwse/pi gwm_yo:/nti h1yo/d lo/wksneh2 ne h1e/sti. nu gho/rtom pe/h2somes. h1yo/d bho:/r gwm_ye:/ti kwi/d dhe/dheh1oh2? do:/m dr_mdhi/ we/wke-kwe nos. tu/H h2yuHn_k'o/s me: wike/s. bhr_bho/s ne tre/soh2. dhr_su/s h2ne:/r e/ti g'n_h3ro/s. k'o/syeh2i kwse/pi bhe/wdhe:si?

h2e/nHe moy h1e/gwhis spe/lom we/wke. h1o/gwhis we/do:r pe/ri le/ghet h1i/h2-kwe ke/wdhet de/h2nuh2-kwe ne sre/wet. kwi/s h1o/gwhim gwhe/nt? pe/rkwunos h1o/gwhim swo/h1 h2k'm_ne/h1 gwhe/nt. nu h1i/h2 spe/rt. swesre/y moy spe/lom we/wko:h2? nu h1i/d we/wke k'le/wso:h2. pe/rkwunos h1o/gwhim gwhe/nt we/do:r-kwe spe/rt. spe/lom wo/ydth2e te/k'neh2 toy h1i/d twe/d k'le/weti.

te/k'nom sne/h2si? ne sne/h2mi de/h2nu dhubhro/m. two/y ku/Hloy l_ghdhi/ dhore/yo:h2-kwe te. nu h2r_Hmo/ns ske/lesh2-kwe Hyowdhe/ye. sne/h2mi. dhore/yesi me? ne te dhore/yoh2 tu/H-ge sne/h2si. moghu/bhos we/wke:si? h1e/ymos we/wko:h2 sme/yonti-kwe.

kwi/d dhh2bhre pr_kwe/ws te:/tk'si? ne/wo:y wo/g'ho:y kwe/kwlom te:/tk'mi. kwi/d pe/rkwum we/lh1s bherHg'o/m ne we/lh1s? pe/rkwus tewh2so/s bherHg'o/s Hrumpto/r. nu h3okwe/h2m h1idhe/ tr_ddhi/. h1i/h2m_ te/rdm_. h3okwe/h2 me/g'h2ih2? h1i/h2 pe/h2ureh2 h1i/h2m_ h2e/ti tr_ddhi/. kwo/m kwe/kwlos wo/g'hoy Hn_dhi/ we/rte:tor? h1yo/d h2e/nterom kwe/kwlom kwe/romes wo/g'hom h1e/lh2esi.

h3re/g' dhh1tle/h2i h2roh1dhe/yo:h2? h2roh1dhe/ye:si g'e/rh2ontn_s k'lowse/ye. kwi/d to/ybhos sokwe/yo:h2? pe/h2ureh2 we/kwesh2 h1so/nth2 sokwe/ye. h1yo/s polh1u/h2 we/kwesh2 we/rh1yeti wiHro:/s to/m ne k'l_nwe/nti. h1yo/d g'e/rh2ontes sme/yonti th2ke/h1yo:h2. me: th2ke/h1yes. dhr_su/ we/kwos k'le/wos we/nt. dhr_su/s h1e/sesi? dhr_su/s h1e/soh2 we/kwesh2-kwe moy h2we/ysesi.

h1su/menes h2we/h1n_ts h2we:/h1ti go/leti-kwe. sno/ygwhos h2ewse/r pe/th1eti. kwi/h1 g'n_ne/h3si? dye:/ws k'a/snos h2e/weyes-kwe th2ke/h1yonti. h2o/wins gho/rtom h1n_do/ wodhe/ye dhwo/rm_-kwe ste/ge. polh1u/s sno/ygwhos pe/th1eti? polh1u/s sno/ygwhos pe/th1eti h2Hse/h2i-kwe se/dyo:mes. spe/lom moy we/rh1esi? h1e/gwhis toy spe/lom we/rh1oh2.

kwi/d g'l_/h2ow gwe/nh2es se/ngwhonti h1yo/d wiHro/s snuso/m we/dheti? k'o/d se/ngwhonti snu/se nos k'e/yweh2 h1sdhi/ k'o/ymosyo po/tnih2 h1sdhi/. kwi/d snuso/s pro/ti mle/wHti? k'o/d sokwe/yeti k'e/yweh2 wos h1e/soh2 h2e/Hsh2m_-kwe wos h2le/kso:h2. k'e/yweh2 wos h1e/soh2 h2e/Hsh2m_-kwe wos h2le/kso:h2. nu nos tu/H swe/so:r.

kwi/h1 h1sn_/tyok'lewes pe/rkwum gwru/h1 dhe/wghs? h3o/kw moy pr_kwe/wi dhore/yom nu gwe/ru tewh2so/h1 h2r_Hmo/h1 Hye/h1km_. gwe/ru moy dh3dhi/ h1i/d-kwe Hye/h1koh2. h1idhe/ sth2dhi/ h1i/d-kwe pe/rkwum pro/ti Hih1kdhi/. h1i/d Hye/h1km_ h1i/d dhg'he/mi pe/th1t. h1i/d h2e/ti Hih1kdhi/ h2r_Hmo/s toy tewh2so/s bhu/Heti. k'ek'o/mh2th2e? ne k'ek'o/mh2h2e h1i/d tri/s Hye/h1koh2.

kwo/m g'e/rh2ont ste/h2dhh1om ko/lHonn_s h1e/lh2omes? h1yo/d sno/ygwhos tine/h1etor ne/wom-kwe ghre/h1mn_ me/lh3eti. kwi/h1 to/m dino/m g'n_ne/h3si? lo/wksneh2 g'hime/s po/s tri/s pl_h1to/ nu u/d ste/yghomes. kl_Hn_su/ se/somes? h2str_su/ Hn_dhi/ se/somes ste/h2dhh1om-kwe se/meh2m pe/h2somes. e/ti gwe/mesi? gwe/moh2 kl_Hno:/m-kwe poh2ime:/n h1e/soh2.

swe/sor po:/lHos kwse/pi g'n_h1ye/to. h1e/y ish1ro/s? stesto/h2e? stesto/h2e h2me/lg'os-kwe pi/ph3eti. kwo/d h1no/mn_ h1e/smey dhe/h1omes? h1e/smey k'luto/m h1no/mn_ dhh1dhi/ h1yo/d h3re:g'e/s h1e/k'wos h1e/seti. h1e/smey k'luto/m h1no/mn_ dhe/h1oh2 h1eg'o/h2-kwe h1i/m de/mh2oh2. h1i/h1 e/ti re/ydho:h2? h1i/h1 po/s re/ydhe:si.

mo/ghew wik'po/tis h1idhe/ h1e/sti? so/ h1idhe/ ne h1e/sti dhh1tle/h2m gwe/h2t. pri/He gho/stey. h2Hse/h2i toy se/dyo:h2? se/dye me/dhu-kwe toy me:/ms-kwe h1ope/yo:h2. tu/H h2yuHn_k'o/s g'n_h3ro/s-kwe. kwi/s toy k'o/d we/rh1t? g'e/rh2ontes k'o/d sokwe/yonti gho/stis dhh1sbho/s lewbho/s. kwi/d toy gho/stey h1no/mn_? h1eg'o/h2 h1wesuk'le/we:s dweh2ro:/d k'o/ymo:d gwm_yo/h2.

kwi/d h2nr_/menes tre/msi? ne tre/mmi. h1eg'o/h2 me/g'h2s. dhe/g'ho:m trome/yeti. dhe/g'ho:m ne trome/yeti. mu/Hs toy ko/lsoy si/sdeti. pri/He h1i/m me/d h2epo/ sl_h2gwdhi/. h1i/m h1pdhi/.

po/h2imen toy k'wo:/ h2Hse/h2i h2e/nti le/gheti wl_/kwos-kwe toy h2o/wins h2epo/ h2e/g'eti. k'wo:/ moy wl_/kwos-kwe priHo/h1. h1i/h2n_s k'o/m h1e/dtes. nu kwi/s h2o/wins pe/h2sti? gwe:/n moy h1i/h2n_s pe/h2sti. wl_/kwos h1e/syeh2s dedwo/ye.

bhre/h2ter po:/lHom dhg'hye/s tl_na:/m. h1e/k'wom tl_na:/m. dwo/h1 h1e/k'woh1 kwe/kwlom-kwe tl_na:/m. dhe/g'ho:m tl_na:/m. nu ku/dhe sth2e/h1yes? bhre/h2ter toy ko/lsoy h1e/pi sth2e/h1yom. ne wide/s?

h1su/k'lewes toy h1e/k'wos HeHk'u/s. HeHk'u/s moy h1e/k'wos HeHk'u/s-kwe h1eg'o/h2. h1e/k'wos toy wl_/kwo:d dhg'hye/s bhe/wgt tu/H-kwe h1e/smi h1e/pi si/sdes. ne bhe/wgm_. wl_/kwom k'o/ymo:d h2epo/ we/dhom. se/kweto te. se/kweto-ge me.

le/ymonm_ dhg'hye/s pe/h3m_. to/smi lime/ni dhg'hye/s h3me/yg'hom. nu wo/dr_ swe/h2dt. k'e/ywe tu/H ph3to/s.

h3re/g' moy misdho/m ne de/h3s. nu twe/ pro/ti kh2no:/h2 gwo/wes-kwe toy me/ronti. gho/stey kh2ne/. h1e/dn_ti ne te k'le/wsonti. nu toy gwe/nh2m_ pro/ti se/ngwho:h2. se/ngwhe. ne me k'le/wseti.

ph2te:/r moy h1o/gwhim gwhe/nt. ph2te:/r moy dwo/h1 h1o/gwhih1 g'hwe:/rm_-kwe gwhe/nt. ph2te:/r moy k'm_to/m h1o/gwhins swo/h1 gwru/h1 gwhe/nt. to/d bhebho/ydhh2e. me/h2te:r toy moy we/wket. muHse/s dedwo/ye.

pri/He gho/stey ke/nkesi? ne ke/nkoh2. nu moy kwi/d moyso/m h2e/k'h3s? tr_syo/m ne ke/nkom. nu wo/dr_ pi/ph3e. wo/dr_ ne pi/ph3oh2. h1eg'o/h2 gho/stis.

su/Hnew h2we/st. sth2dhi/. ph2ter memo/nh2e. kwi/d memo/nth2e? kwi/s h2e/g'rom h2e/rh3ye:ti? tu/H h1i/m h2e/rh3ye:si. nu h2ew le/ghoh2.

kwi/d po/tey dhwo/rm_ kapye/si? po/tni dhe/g'ho:m we/rtetor. dhe/g'ho:m ne we/rtetor. tu/H ph3to/s. nu kwi/d dwo/yh1 po/tnih2h1 dedo/rk'h2e? sme/ytes.

g'e/rh2ont moy we/wke. k'o/smi dino/y h2we/rseti? mo/ghew h2we/rseti. kwi/h1 wo/ydth2e? wo/ydh2e. po/tnih2 moy h2wl_/h1neh2m h2sowse/yeti. h1yo/d h2wl_/h1neh2m h2sowse/yeti h2we/rst.

wi/Hre gwo:/m h2me/lg's? h1su/menes h1i/h2m_ h2me/lg'm_. nu kwi/d h1e/syeh2s h1o/wHdhr_ ple/h1dheti? nu kwi/d h2me/lg'm_? ka/prom h2me/lg's. ghre/meti. ne ghre/meti sme:/yti.

kwi/h1 me/h2ter ph2tre/y we/wko:h2? kwi/d su/Hnew h1e/smey we/wke:si? po:/lHos yugo/m Hrune/pt. h1e/smey wr_h1dhi/. ph2ter toy po:/lHos Hwe/rdht. yugo/m Hrune/pt. ne ghre/me:ti? nu h1e/smey wr_h1dhi/. gwe:/n toy to/d h2e/g't.

g'e/nh1tri moy h2wl_pe/ys spe/lom we/wke. h2wl_/pis k'o/ymom ne/kwti gwe/mt. h2o/wins wide/t. nu kwi/d dhe/h1t? h1i/h2n_s gwr_h3e/t. nu l_ghdhi/. h2wl_pe/ys dedwo/yh2e. me: bhe/yh2s. h2wl_/pis medte/h2.

gho/stey tri/s h2we/st. pri/He me tri/s h2e/les. tu/H h1use/wo:m de/h3to:r. gwo/wes moy lelikwe:/r dhra:/ks-kwe lelo/ykwe. nu toy h2Hse/h2i h1e/pi si/sdo:h2. nu kwid toy ne h1e/sti priHo/s-kwe toy h1e/sti.

h2ne/r k'lush1ye/si? bho:/r h1n_do/m h1e/sti. de/ywog'enh1es h1i/m k'lush1yo/h2. nu sth2dhi/ h1i/m-kwe h1pdhi/. bho:/r me k'lush1ye/ti. dedwo/ye h1eg'o/h2-kwe dedwo/yh2e. nu h1eg'o/h2 h1i/m h1e/poh2. nu bhe/wgt.

kwi/s wi/Hre dh2pno/m h2e/k'h3t? k'e/ywa mu/Hs to/d h2e/k'h3t. mu/Hs me/g'h2 dh2pno/m gwr_h3e/t? nu bhindto/. bhindto/-ge. nu str_h3me/ni k'e/yor. tu/H so/ mu/Hs.

kwi/s po/tey pe/rdt? po/tni k'wo:/ pe/rdt. h2e/g'roy h2e/wibhis k'o/m h1e/sti. nu h2e/g'ro:d pe/rdetor. so/ me/g'h2s k'wo:/. tu/H me/g'h2s k'wo:/.

se/ne h1eg'o/h2 deywo/s. gwo:/s moy toy dh3dhi/. nu h1i/ns sl_h2gwdhi/. k'wo:/ moy deywo/s. h1i/ns pe/h2sti. so/ ne deywo/s. nu tu/H ne deywo/s. h2epo/ gwh2dhi/.

po/tey moy dayh2we:/r wl_/kwos. kwi/d le/wbha to/d bhe/h2si? h2o/wins nos h1e:/dti ne/kwti-kwe Hre/wdHti. ne Hre/wdHti gwe/Hyeti. nu kwi/d gho/steyes bhuge/nt?

dhugh2te:/r h3re:g'e/y h1e/st ne-kwe sme:/yt. h3re:/g's se/kwt. h1yo/d moy dhugh2te:/r sme/yeti to/smey wiHro:/y h1i/h2m_ de/h3oh2. polh1e/wes h2ne/res h1ludho/nt h1i/h2-kwe ne sme:/yt. nu h2yuHn_k'o/s poh2imne/s suHnu/s gwe/mt. ka/proy h1e/pi si/sdet. ka/pros pe/rdt. nu dhugh2te:/r sme:/yt. h3re:/g's poh2imne/s suHno/wey h1i/h2m_ de/h3t.

h2wl_/pis spe/rm_ h1e/pt. spe:/r h2e/g't. h2wl_/pey deywo/ns gwr_nHdhi/ nu-kwe me h1ddhi/. h2wl_/pis h1i/ns gwr_ne/Ht. spe:/r h1e/syeh2s sth3me/ns bhe/wgt. nu h2wl_/pis mle/wHt. h1i/ns h2ew ne gwr_ne/Hoh2.

h2r_/tk'os h2e/g'roy k'e/yo. mu/Hs h1i/m upe/r ste/yghet. h2r_/tk'os bhe/wdht mu/Hsm_-kwe h1e/pt. mu/Hs tre/mt. h2r_/tk'os sme:/yt h1i/m-kwe le/h1t. mu/Hs swo/ns bhre/h2tern_s dre/mt se/kwt-kwe. bhre/h2teres h2r_/tk'os me/d tre/mt.

dwo/h1 bho/rh1e gwo:/m ne/kwti kle/peta:m. h2we/st to/h1-kwe ghre/meta:m. se/nos h2e/g't. h1eg'o/h2 gwo:/m kle/pom. h2ye/wHo: se/kwt. h1eg'o/h2 h1i/h2m_ kle/pom. h1regwesye/t. h1i/h2 swo/m k'o/ymom gwe/h2t poh2ime:/n-kwe h1i/h2m_ h2me/lg't.

ph3to/s h2ne:/r lo/wksneh2m lime/ni wide/t. lo/wksneh2 le/ymonm_ se/ngwt h2e/g't. le/ymonm_ pe/h3oh2 lo/wksneh2m-kwe spe/roh2. no/kwtm_ pe/r pi/ph3et. h2we/st lo/wksneh2-kwe ne/k't. k'o/ymom gwe/h2t we/wket-kwe. po/tni lo/wksneh2m pe/h3m_. nu h1eg'o/h2 medto/s.

h2wl_/pis wl_kwih2e/y we/rh1t. h1yo/d gwe/Hyesi h2o/weyes trome/yonti. gwh2dhi/ k'o/ymoy-kwe h2e/nti gwe/Hye. wl_kwi/h2s gwe/h2t gwe/Hyet-kwe. poh2ime/nes h1i/h2m_ k'luwe/nt dr_me/nt-kwe. h2epo/ dre/mt. h2wl_/pis moyso/m h2e/n h1e/pt. nu h2wl_/pis h2e/g't. wl_/kwih2 h2ew gwe/Hye. moyso/s swe/h2dt.

bho:/r se/neh2s dhwo/rm_ ne/kwti gwe/mt. h1i/h2 h1i/m k'le/wt. Hre/wdHt. po/tey sth2dhi/. gwe/ru bhe/re. da/yh2weres gwm_te/. bho:/r h2epo/ dre/mt. se/neh2 gwe:/n mu/Hs-kwe h2e/n tk'ita:/m.

ka/pros kwe/kwloy h1e/pi sth2e/h1yet. h2r_/tk'os h1ludhe/t ka/pros-kwe sme:/yt. h2r_/tk'e h1idhe/ ne memo/ghth2e. nu kwe/kwlos we/rteto. ka/prom h1i/m pro/ti we/g'het. so/ mle/wHt. pri/He gho/stey gwm_dhi/.

g'e/rh2onts pe/rkwunom dh2pno/y gwr_ne/Ht. nu pe/rdt. h2yuHn_k'o:/s sme/yn_t. g'e/rh2onts sokwe/yet. me: sme/yte. pe/rkwunos ghre/met. k'le/wt me. nu h2yuHn_k'o:/s pe/rkwunom gwr_nHe/nt.

ne/kwti kwis moy h2Hse/h2i h2e/nti ghre/meti. so/ pe/rkwunos? ne h2we/rst. so/ moy str_h3me/ni k'e/ym_h1nos po/tis.

h1e:/dti ne-kwe wr_g'ye/ti. to/d moy ne dayh2we:/r. h1yo/d wo/dr_ pi/ph3e:ti me/rt. dayh2we:/r moy wo/dr_ ne pi/ph3eti. to/d pe/h2wr_.

h1i/m kwis ne we/dheti dh2pno/m-kwe gwm_sk'e/ti. h3re:/g'i h2e/nti h1e:/dti. wiHro:/s h1e/smo:d tre/sonti gwe/nh2es-kwe HrudHe/nti. so/ mu/Hs.

kwi/s dwo/yh1 lo/wksneh2h1 dye/wi dedo/rk'e? kwi/s steh2uro:/y h2roh1dhe/yeti? kwi/s dhwo/ri h2e/nti le/gheti h1e/syo-kwe gwe:/n h1i/m upe/r ste/ygheti? ph3to/s h2ne:/r.

g'r_h2n_te/s g'n_h1yo/h2er. ste/h3mn_ moy ne h1e/sti bhe/h2mi-kwe. gho/steyes me k'lush1yo/nti lite/nt-kwe. ne kwis me gwr_ne/Hti. g'e/rh2onts pe/rdt.

bho:/r h1e/syeh2s bhebho/yh2e h1e/syeh2s po/tis h1e/syeh2s bhebho/yh2e. h1yo/d mu/Hsm_ wide:/ti Hre/wdHti kwe/kwlom-kwe h1e/pi ste/ygheti. kwi/s se/h2? se/h2 po/tnih2.

h2nr_/menes toy k'le/wos me/g'h2. HeHk'u/m-ge mu/Hsm_ h2Hse/h2h1 k'o/m gwhe/ns. nu mu/Hs le/ghet tu/H-kwe-ge tre/ms. h2nr_/menes h1i/m gwru/h1 tri/s stune/ds. wi/Hre toy k'le/wos n_/dhgwhitom. bhre/h2te:r toy swe/so:r-kwe sme/ytes.

gho/stey h1yo/s moyso/ns gwr_h3e/si. h1yo/s-kwe nos dhra:/ghm_ pi/ph3esi. h1yo/s nos str_h3me/ni le/ghesi k'ludhi/ nos. h2e/n gwh2dhi/ deywo:/s toy h1we/suh2 h2e/n dh3ih1e/nt.

nu ph3to/m h2ne/rm_ se/ngwho:mes. le/ymonm_ pe/h3t srowe/h2m-kwe pe/h3t. nu h2use/si h2ew tr_sye/ti. dhwo/ri-kwe h2e/nti gwe/Hyeti. nu gwi/h3woyh1t dhra:/ks-kwe h1e/smo:d me: lelikwye/h1t.

mu/Hses bhre/h2teres HrudHte/. se/nos nos gho/stis k'o/ymom gwe/mt. dh2pno/m h2e/k'h3t h2e/Hsh2m_-kwe le/yg'ht. nu-kwe kwid n_sme/y ne h1e/sti. ke/nkomes h2e/g'rom bhe/wgomes.

nu moy suHnu/m wiHro/m kh2no:/h2. h2e/g'roy kwid ne h2e/rh3yeti. ne kwid tl_ne/h2ti ne-kwe kwid bhe/reti. moyso/m dh2pno/y h1e:/dti pe/h3t-kwe. nu h1e/syo k'le/wos me/g'h2 h1sye/h1t.

ku/dhe nos h2e/wh2e pe/k'u h1e/sti? h2e/lyo:s h1i/d ne/kwti h2e/g'ont. ph2te:/r toy swo/h1 g'hoyso/h1 gho/rdhoy sth2e/h1yet. nu moy ku/dhe ph2te:/r h1e/sti? se/ngwt dusme/neses-kwe h1i/m gwhne/nt. te/k'nom me: Hre/wdHs. ne Hre/wdHmi. h1i/m memo/nh2e. memn_dhi/ Hwr_dhdhi/-kwe.

wi/k'potey moy dhugh2tre/y h2r_g'n_to/m h1e/k'wons-kwe we/dhoh2. kwoyne/h2m h1a/yso h1i/h2m_-kwe l_h1dhi/. te/we h2r_g'n_to/m ne h1a/yoh2er. dhugh2te:/r toy me/ne ste/gesi te/kseti. g'e/rh2ont gwh2dhi/ me:-kwe me ghrome/yes. dye:/ws k'o/d kwk'ye/h1t kwe/yoyh1t-kwe te. te/we deywo/ybhos ne dedwo/yh2e.

gho/stey moy suHnu/m kwe/k's? wiHro:/s h1i/m pe/rwo:r h1r_h1pyo/nt. gwe:/n toy suHnu/m ne kwe/k'm_. gwo:/s te/k'nom-kwe h2e/g'ontn_s wiHro/ns dhg'hye/s kwe/k'm_. de/h2nu pro/ti ste/yghont. te/k'nom trome/yet? ne trome/yet gwo:/s se/kweto. nu de/h2nu h1e/ymi. me/h2ter mo/k's h1idhi/ deywo:/s-kwe te ph2sih1e/nt.

ku/dhe me/h2ter h1sme/s? ghoste/yo:m de/mi h1sme/s. k'o/ymom toy h1e/wsont h1idhe/-kwe te h1l_h2e/nt. kwi/s tu/H? swe/h2s me h2Hse/h2s e/ti h1r_h1pyo/nt. nu po/tn_yeh2ey g'r_h2no/m ghre/ndhoh2. me/h2term_ moy h2e/ti wido:/h2? swe/h2m ne wido/m. nu h2yu/Hn_k'a da/k'ruh2 g'hudhi/ h2e/yeri wr_g'ye/si.

pri/He sme/yn_tn_s h1i/ns k'lush1ye/si? h1i/ns k'lush1yo/h2. h1e/yso:m h1e/h1ughos me/g'h2. te/mHesi ni/ ste/ygho:mes pe/k'u-kwe h2e/ti sle/h2gwomes. to/y polh1e/wes we/y-kwe pe/h2uro:s. ne/k'ewes nos bhre/h2teres dhwo/ri k'e/yror. nu se/dyo:mes Hre/wdHomes-kwe? h1i/ns dhg'he/mi loghe/yo:mes nu sme/yn_tn_s h1i/ns kwe/yo:mesdhh2.

kwi/d dhu/gh2ter Hre/wdHsi? gho/stey Hre/wdHmi. h2e/Hsh2m_ moy memo/nh2e. ku/dhe toy do:/m h1e/sti? h1e/y h2ewse/r dweh2ro/s. k'o/syo moy k'o/ymosyo h2ne/res g'n_h1yo/m more/yont. kwoyne/h2m toy kwinuye/h1m_. deywo:/s toy h1we/suh2 dh3ih1e/nt. po/tis moy te/we h2elgwho/m ne h1a/yetor. nu h1i/m dh2pno/y pre/k'soh2.

ku/dhe gwo/wes gwh2e/nt? h2e/lyo:s h1i/h2n_s h2e/yeri h2e/g'ont. ph2te:/r moy h1i/ns pro/ti wike/t? gho/rdhoy h1i/ns pro/ti wike/t me/rt-kwe. nu nos kwi/s pe/h2sti? su/Hnew moy nos tu/H pe/h2si. nu tu/H h2ne:/r. h1eg'o/h2 pe/h2uros bhebho/yh2h2e-kwe. ph2te:/r toy e/ti tre/set ste/h2t-kwe.

wi/k'potey gwegwo/mh2e suHnu/m moy h2isk'o/h2. de/k'm_ toy gwo:/s de/deh3mi. h1e/y moy ste/gesi ne h1e/sti. mre/ys wiHro/ybhos h1i/m pe/rh2m_. ku/dhe h1i/m we/dhont? ne wo/ydh2e. h1e/yso:m ne/h2wes we/kwsperom pro/ti h1ye/nt. nu ne/h2wn_s se/kwo:h2er. g'e/rh2ont mo/ri me/g'h2 tu/H-kwe somHo/s.

wi/Hre bhudhdhi/. k'wo/nes yug'He/nt. k'oph2o/ns dhe/yg'hesi h1e/pi k'lush1yo/h2. te/k'neh2 sl_h2gwdhi/ gwowsth2o/y-kwe kudhso/. somHo/s tu/H wike/si? bhre/h2tr_bhis moy k'o/m wiko/h2. nu po/tni dr_mdhi/. po/tey te deywo:/s ph2sih1e/nt.

me/h2ter toy h1eg'o/h2 mo/ghus. ne/sm_. me/ne mo/ghew. h1eg'o/h2 ti/srn_s se/ma:s lug're/h2 h1e/sm_. kwi/h1 bhe/wgs? h1esh2o:/s moy sse/nt kwse/pi-kwe bhe/wgm_. h2yu/Hn_k'e ke/nkesi? h1ddhi/. ke/nkoh2. h2e/wh2os moy gwi/h3weti? gwi/h3weti ste/h2dhh1oh1 k'o/m h1e/sti.

ku/dhe po/h2imen g'n_h1ye/th2e? pe/runsu g'n_h1yo/h2e. h2e/wh2os moy wik'po/tis h1e/st. kwi/h1 h3o/rbhos bhu/Hs? kh3te/wi nos une/nt lm_bhe/nt-kwe me. nu swo:/m po/yk'o:m h2o/wins pe/h2smi. do:/m toy lubhye/si? h1i/m lubhyo/h2 h1i/m su/pniyoy ne/kwtsu wide/h1yoh2. po/h2imen ne/soyh1th2e.

kwo/ti wiHro/ns bhre/h2ter gwhne/nt? septm_/ nos wiHro/ns h2e/wh2om-kwe gwhne/nt. nu ku/dhe gwe/nh2es h1se/nti? gwe/nh2n_s te/k'neh2-kwe pk'u/h1 k'o/m h2e/g'ont. swe/sorm_ nos e/ti sl_h2gwe/nt? h1i/h2m_ e/ti sl_h2gwe/nt. HrudHn_ti/h2m h1i/h2m_ wido/m. nu h1i/ns se/kwo:mesdhh2. h1i/ns h2e/yeri se/kwo:mesdhh2 ne/k'uns nos k'o/smi dino/y dhg'he/mi loghe/yomes.

ph2tre/s toy do:/m me/g'h2s h1e/st? h1e/y me/g'h2s h1e/st polh1e/wes-kwe ukse/nes gwowsth2o/y sth2e/h1yont. nu kwi/s h2e/n tk'e/yti? h2e/n kwis ne tk'e/yti. dusme/neses h1i/m h1e/wsont. po/teyes nos h1i/m h1e/wsont? h1i/m h1e/wsont. h1e/ymos k'o/d me: we/wkes. th2ke/h1yoh2. th2ke/h1ye gwi/h3we-kwe.

po/tni h2e/h2usom h2wl_/h1neh2m-kwe bhe/re. po/yk'o:m wo/yk'om h1r_sk'o/h2. me: h1e/ys. more/yo:nti te. dhugh2te:/r nos kapte/h2. h1e/syeh2s kwoyne/h2m kwine/woh2. h1yo/d h2e/h2usom h1a/yontor h1i/h2m_-kwe ne le/h1onti? nu deywo:/s to/d de/rk'onti. nu gwh2dhi/ diwe/y-kwe h2me/lg'os g'hudhi/.

h1yo/d po/yk'o:s gwme/nt ku/dhe h1e/s? gwowsth2o/y kudhh2e/. tu/H kudhth2e/ h2ne/res-kwe m_re/nt. bhe/yh2m_. h1eg'o/h2 h2yuHn_k'o/s. kwi/d kwe/k's? h1e/yso:m wik'po/tim kwe/k'm_. h1e/syo ske/ytos h1rudhe/h1t sme:/yt-kwe. nu h1i/m g'n_ne/h3esi. me/g'hye k'o/m gwm_dhi/.

kwi/d me po/tni spe/k'yesi? suHnu/s moy kh3te/wi pe/ruti me/rt. k'o/ymosyo toy h2ne/res h1i/m gwhne/nt. te/we moy suHnu/s bhre/h2term_ more/yet. nu Hrupyo/wos. ph2we/ni h1e/pi sddhi/ h1ddhi/-kwe. h1e:/dmi. h1i/m memo/nh2e.

wi/k'potey moy po/yk'o:s po/tim lm_bhe/nt. h1e/ymos kwoyne/h2m dh3dhi/. kwi/d pre/k'sn_t? k'm_to/m gwo:/s pre/k'sn_t. k'm_to/m gwo/wes. nu nos te/k'neh2 ke/nkoyh1t. nu moy po/tis ghosti/su me/dhi me/reti. to/d ne we/k'mi. kwoyne/h2m se:mi kwine/womes. h1yo/d h1i/h2m_ ne h1e/monti? nu h1i/m g'hoyso:/ys h2e/ti sle/h2gwomes.

ku/dhe gho/stey h2e/yeri h1e/ysi? h2ewse/r h1e/ymi. me/h2te:r moy me/g'h2i de/h2newi h1e/pi tk'e/yti. h1e/syeh2ey k'o/d we/wke. dhugh2te:/r toy gwi/h3weti. kwi/d h1e/syeh2s h1no/mn_? h1i/h2 h1suk'le/we:s wik'po/teys h1widhe/wh2. h1i/h2m_ wine/doh2 h1e/syeh2ey-kwe we/rh1oh2. pri/He moy tu/H k'e/ywos.

g'r_/h2enti polh1u/h2 wo/ydth2e. mo/ghus moy gwi/h3weti? gwi/h3weti. wo/dr_ dweh2ro/y bhr_h1we/ni bhe/reti. ke/nketi? h1i/m stunde/nti? ke/nketi h1i/m-kwe stunde/nti. h1e/syo k'e:/r dhr_su/. ne/se:tor? to/d ne dedo/rk'h2e. deywo/ns g'huHe/ye.

h2e/wh2e h2e/ti gwm_yo/nti? sh1se/ni gwm_yo/nti. nu me/g'h2 dhe/yg'hos de/mo:mes. dhe/yg'hos moy bhre/h2term_ ne spe/rt. kwi/d nos spe/reti? bhe/wdhonts h2ne:/r HeHk'e/wes-kwe h1e/k'wo:s. k'o/syeh2i ne/kwti bhe/wdhoh2. bhe/wdhe se/smi-kwe.

ghoste/ys te/ntloy h1idhe/ te/ksmi. po/tn_yeh2ey wo/dr_ bhe/roh2. swo/s do:/m dweh2ro/s po/tis moy gho/rdhoy k'e/yor. h1i/m kwis dhg'he/mi ne loghe/yet. nu me me/h2ter k'lush1ye/si? da/k'ruh2-ge g'he:/m ne-kwe kwis k'lush1ye/ti.

mo/ghew te h2e/yeri lm_bhe/nt. nu te h2e/wibhis k'o/m h1l_h2e/nt. pe/h3tlom toy h1idhe/ h2susye/ti. pri/He te h2e/g'roysu h2isk'o/h2. poh2ime/nn_s pre:/k'sm_ th2ke/h1yonti-kwe. kwi/s te me/g'hye do:/m we/dheti? le/wbhe te h2e/ti wido/yh1m_.

sn_gwe/nt mo/rto:s gho/rdhoy h1idhe/. nu nos ste/h2dhh1om g'hoyso:/ys h2le/ksont. gwhe/ntores-ge polh1e/wes h1se/nt. ne/k'ewes nos dhg'he/mi k'e/yror. nu-kwe we/y gwe/nh2es lug're/h2es. h1e/yso:m k'le/wos n_/dhgwhitom h1sye/h1t. nu gwe:/n h1e/yso:m h1no/mn_h2 gwe/Hye. h1le/wdheyes-ge h1i/ns memnih1e/nt.

h2e/k'monh1e g'r_h2no/m ghre/ndhetom. h1esh2o:/y moy me/lh2mi g'ho/stoh1 moy k'm_h2ta:/m. h2e/nHos-ge moy bhr_h1we/ni h1e/pi me/lh2t. h2e/n moy swesr_bhi/s k'o/m gwe/Hyom. somHe/h2 h1eg'o/h2 h1idhe/ gwe/Hyoh2. h2e/k'mon ghre/ndhe nu no/kwts dweh2re/h2.

h3re:g'e/y-ge h2e/h2usom bhe/rom. nu h1e/smey h2r_g'n_to/m gwo:/s-kwe de/deh3m_. de/h3o:r moy ne h1a/yto sme:/yt we/rteto-kwe. dhugh2te:/r moy h1e/syo ste/gesi te/ksti. nu h2e/h2usom h2e/ti we/g'hoh2. dye/w moy ph2ter k'e/h2dos dr_k'dhi/.

gwo/wes moy gwowsth2o:/d lelikwe:/r. wetso:/s ke/nkonti h2me/lg'os-kwe ne h1e/sti. nu moy ne/potes Hrupyo/nti. dusme/neses-kwe nos h2me/lg'os pi/ph3onti. uksno:/m-kwe nos me:/ms h1e/dn_ti. pe/rkwune h1i/ns h2k'm_ne/h1 kl_h2dhi/.

nu mre/y h1e/pi se/dyoh2 h2ewse/r-kwe spe/k'yoh2. swe/so:r moy h1me/ h2e/n me/neti. po/tnih2-ge moy h2Hse/h2i lug're/h2. h1eg'o/h2 h1le/wdheros h1e/sm_ h1eg'o/h2 h3o/rbhos. h2e/nh1me moy we/kwos mo/ri pe/r bhe/re.

po/yk'o:s sh1se/ni pe/runbhos gwme/nt. k'wo/nes yug'He/nt gwe/nh2es-kwe bhudhe/nt. nu Hyudhsmo:/s g'hoyso:/ys u/d dr_me/nt. dusme/neses h1i/ns h2e/n gwhne/nt gwo:/s-kwe h2e/g'ont. gwe/nh2n_s h2yuHn_k'o/ns-kwe h1r_h1pyo/nt wo/yk'om-kwe h1e/wsont. h1o/yneh2 g'r_h2e/ntih2 gwowsth2o/y kudhto/. k'o/d de/rk't h1i/d-kwe nos we/wket.

Hyudhsmo:/s poh2imne/s ne/potm_ de/h2newi h1r_h1pyo/nt. h1e/syo h2e/nHos h1i/m h1ne/wn_ dino/ns h2isk'e/t. nu h1e/yso:m wo/yk'om h1ludhe/t. swo/m wo/dr_ bhe/rontm_ ne/potm_ dhwo/ri de/rk't. h1esh2o:/y swo/m h2r_g'n_to/m de/h3t. h1esh2o/s to/d h1e/mt mo/ghum-kwe le/h1t. h2e/nHos ne/po:ts-kwe ne/sonto h1i/h2-kwe da/k'ruh2 mo/wdoh1 g'he/wt.

h2e/lyo:s h3re:g'e/s ne/potm_ bhr_dhe/nt. h1e/yso:m gwo:/s tri/h2 we/tesh2 bhe/rghet. we/kwsperoysu h2ewse/r spe/k'yet. nu HeHk'u/m h1e/k'wom sle/h2gwt kwse/pi-kwe bhe/wgt. h1e/syo h1esh2o:/s h1i/m se/kwonto. h1e/y h1e/yso:m h1e/k'woybhos He/Hk'yo:s h1e/st. h2e/yeri ne/st. h1e/syo h2e/wh2os h1i/m de/rk't h2e/k'ruh2-kwe g'he/wt.

Hyudhsmo:/s h2yuHn_k'e/h2m poh2imne/s dhugh2te/rm_ h1r_h1pyo/nt. h1e/yso:m g'r_h2no/m ghre/ndhet h2wl_/h1neh2m-kwe te/kst. h1i/h2 h1e/yso:m wo/yk'oy g'r_h2e/ntih2 bhu/Ht. gho/stipoteys ne/potn_s h2e/let. gho/stipoteys mo/ghus h1i/h2m_ pre:/k'st. ku/dhe toy k'o/ymos h1e/sti? se/kwt. h1e/syo h1no/mn_ ne memo/nh2e. h1i/h2 ne/kwtsu lug're/h2 h1e/st swo/syo-kwe k'o/ymosyo ke/h2nmn_h2 gwe/Hyet.

h3re:/g's g'r_h2n_te/s dhugh2te/rm_ le/mbht. se/nos h1e/smey h2e/h2usom h2r_g'n_to/m-kwe we/dhet. h3re:/g's te/h2 ne h1e/mt se/nom-kwe h2epo/ g'he/yt. se/nos mre/y h1e/pi se/dt dye:/m-kwe g'huHe/yet. dye:/ws h1i/m k'le/wt. mo/ros Hyudhsmo/ns gwo:/s-kwe h1ne/wn_ dino/ns more/yet. nu h3re:/g's dhugh2te/rm_ le/h1t se/no:y-kwe de/h3o:r de/h3t.

h2e/lyo:s nos gwo:/s de/h2nu pe/r h2e/g'ont. ugwse/nn_s nos to/syeh2i kwse/pi h2k'h3e/nt me/dhu-kwe ph3e/nt. ghr_h1me/ni le/ghyome h1e/yso:m-kwe h1e/h1ughos h2wisme/. h1e/yso:m h3re:/g's h2e/g't. we/y k'o/ybhos poh2imn_bho/s dhe/rsyoses. h1e/yso:m nos gwe/nh2es g'r_h2no/m ghre/ndho:nti. ne trome/yome. g'hoyso/ns nos kapyo/me h2e/wsosm_-kwe me/nome. pe/k'u nos h2ewse/r lm_bhme/.

dusme/neses h2yuHn_k'e/h2m h1r_h1pyo/nt mre/ys-kwe h2nr_bho/s h1i/h2m_ pr_h2e/nt. h1e/syeh2s bhre/h2te:r h1i/h2m_ tri/h2 we/tesh2 h2isk'e/t. nu dweh2ro/m ste/gos h1ludhe/t. kapte/h2 Hyudhsmo/ybhos me/dhu h2e/n g'he/wt. swe/h2m swe/sorm_ g'ne/h3t. h1esh2o:/y h1e/syeh2s kwoyne/h2m kwine/wt ne/sonto-kwe.

po/yk'e toy gwo/wes m_rih1e/nt. h2e/g'roysu-kwe toy me: h2wr_sye/h1t. ste/gos toy te/mHesi dhe/gwhoyh1t. wetso:/s-kwe toy me: h2uksih1e/nt. h1no/mn_ kwis toy me: gwr_nHye/h1t. k'wo/nes-kwe te h2e/weyes-kwe h1e/dih1ent.

gho/rdhe moy gwo:/s kwse/pi ph2sdhi/. k'wo/nes h1re/gwesi bhe/wdhete. gwhe/nto:r-kwe sto/yghom me: wido/yh1t. h1e/syo-kwe h1e/k'wos h1i/m Hih1kye/h1t. pe/rkwune h1i/m h2k'm_ne/h1 kl_h2dhi/. gwo/wes moy gwowsth2o/m we/kwsperoy gwm_yo/yh1ent.

nu me h2e/wsos diwe/s dhu/gh2ter k'ludhi/. dhugh2te:/r moy h2e/lyoysu me/dhi kapte/h2. nu h1e/syeh2ey lukdhi/ sto/yghom-kwe de/yk'e. h1i/h2m_ spr_dhi/ me/g'hye-kwe h1i/h2m_ we/dhe. h2me/lg'os toy me/lit-kwe de/h3oh2.

h2e/h2usom moy ne h1a/yth2e sme:/ys Hrupyo/m-kwe. dhugh2te:/r-kwe toy kapte/h2 h1sye/h1t. nu h2e/lyoybhos g'r_h2no/m ghre/ndhoyh1t. h1i/h2m_-ge h2isk'o/yh1s h1i/h2m_-kwe me: wido/yh1s. h3e/pnos-kwe toy twe/ me: spr_ye/h1t.

no/kwtes me sk'h3ye/h2h1 k'e/lete. k'wo/nes dhwo/ri th2ke/h1yete. gho/stipoteyes moy ssih1e/nt. nu me sto/yghe h2ewse/r we/dhe. de/h2nu me we/g'he h2e/Hsh2m_ moy h1ludho/yh1m_.

gwhe/ntor nos Hyudhsmo/ns gho/rdhoy gwhe/ns. h1e/yso:m h1widhe/wh2es lug're/h2es. gwhe/ntor toy g'hoyso/s Hrumpih1to/. h1e/k'wo:s twe/d h2epo/ bhugih1e/nt. somHo/s tu/H te/mHesi mr_ye/h1s. dhg'he/mi kwis te me: loghe/yoyh1t. nu toy gwhe/ntor h1no/mn_ n_k'ye/h1t.

kwi/d me/h2ter Hre/wdHsi? ph2te:/r toy mr_to/s. h1e/terosyo g'e/nh1esos h2yuHn_k'o:/s h1i/m dh2pno/y gwhne/nt. dusme/ne:s h1i/m k'e/stroh1 ke/lh2t kwse/pi-kwe bhe/wgt. h1e/syo g'n_h1yo/m kwoyne/h2m de/h3eti? sme/yn_ti. ne kwid ghe/ldho:nti. kwi/d me/h2ter dhe/dheh1oh2? te/k'nom h2uksdhi/. h1yo/d wiHro/s h1e/sesi dusme/nesm_ kwe/yeso. h1i/m kwe/yo:h2er.

kwi/d pri/He dh2pno/y ne/kwti wide/s? kre/wh2s pe/h3tloysu wido/m. wik'po/teys g'm_ro/s swe:k'uro/m ke/lh2t. swe:k'uro/s mr_two/s? h1e/y mr_two/s. gwe/nh2es dhwo/ri HrudHe/nti. kwi/d wik'po/tis pre/k'seti? k'm_to/m gwo:/s pre/k'seti. to/d kwoyne/h2. h1yo/d g'm_ro/s ne kwine/weti? nu swe:k'uro/syo bhre/h2teres h1i/m kwe/yo:ntor. se/h2 kwse/ps h2eghe/h2 h1e/st.

g'e/rh2ont me k'ludhi/. h1suh1e/k'wos moy bhre/h2term_ dh2pno/y more/yet. to/d k'le:/m. h1e/sh2r_ we/k'si kwoyne/h2m-we: we/k'si? h1e/sh2r_ we/k'mi. bhre/h2te:r moy me/g'hye priHo/s h1e/st. h1yo/d h1e/syo kre/wh2s g'he/wesi h1e/syo bhre/h2teres twe/ pye/h2onti. h3e/pnos sl_h2gwdhi/ te/k'neh2-kwe toy gwi/h3wetu. h3e/pnos sle/h2gwoh2. bhre/h2term_ moy ne me/rsoh2.
